title: Clay, light, and patient hands
alt: A ceramic artist paints blue flowers on a pale celadon vessel at her studio workbench.
description: A quiet studio portrait: a fine brush, hand-painted ceramic, worn wood and soft window light.
prompt: A refined candid editorial photograph of an adult female ceramic artist in a sunlit workshop. The camera clearly shows exactly two natural hands: her left hand steadies a pale celadon bowl on the workbench while her right hand holds a fine brush painting a single cobalt botanical motif on its exterior. Believable finger anatomy and brush contact. The richly layered studio contains shelves of varied finished ceramics, sketches without lettering, glaze samples, a worn linen apron, dust in the slanting light and a flowering branch in a tall vase. Beautiful skin tones, tactile clay, subtle glaze reflections, quiet concentration, fresh pale celadon, cobalt and warm terracotta. Complex photographic scene with a clear human gesture, no text.
